prompt: What caused the largest spike at the far right?
promptZh: 什麼造成最右側最大的尖峰？

options.text: A change in motor speed during the test.
options.whyZh: 那時馬達已關閉，所以不是測試期間的轉速改變。

options.text: The stand striking the floor during transport.
options.whyZh: 女方只提到機體被從支架抬起，並未提到支架撞地。

options.text: A new unit being switched on.
options.whyZh: 談到的是原機體的馬達關閉後被移開，不是另一台被開啟。

options.text: The unit being lifted off its stand.
options.whyZh: 女方說尖峰出現在馬達關閉後，是把機體抬離支架時造成的，不是馬達運轉造成的。

explanationZh: 女方說尖峰出現在馬達關閉後，是把機體抬離支架時造成的，不是馬達運轉造成的。
evidence: Check the grey band on the chart. It marks the time after we switched the motor off. That spike is from lifting the unit off the stand, not from running the motor.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Check the grey band on the chart. It marks the time after we switched the motor off. That spike is from lifting the unit off the stand, not from running the motor.

vocabulary.note: lift the unit off the stand 表示把機體完全抬離支架。
